title: fix: require trusted hosts for signed identity requests
quote: Signed identity requests must bind to an independently configured receiving host. Reconstructing their URL solely from an incoming Host header allows a relay to present another service's signed request.

title: mppx@0.22.1 release notes
quote: Fixed macOS account storage passing the private key in security process arguments. The CLI now sends the keychain command on stdin through security -i. Stripped Forwarded, X-Real-IP, True-Client-IP, CF-Connecting-IP and Via from proxied requests, as X-Forwarded-* already is.

title: [Bug]: SVM exact: Phantom adds a Lighthouse assertion on the facilitator's fee payer, so Phantom payments fail verify (fee_payer_transferring_funds)
quote: Before signing, Phantom adds Lighthouse assertion instructions to the transaction, and one of them names the facilitator's fee payer (extra.feePayer). @x402/svm 2.32.0 refuses any Lighthouse instruction that includes the fee payer in its accounts... so Phantom users can't pay x402 on Solana through facilitators that use this rule.
